what_if.policy_reading: The policy's ratio is LOLLI_n / max(ERGOL_n, 1). Here citations_n is read literally from the policy's own source line, as the summed change of citation_count over the cycle; the three other components of ERGOL are set to 0; LOLLI_n is the number of files created, a catalogue file included. This reading is an assumption of the fixture, not a record of how the project applies the policy.

power_law_rule.reading_note: The rule's population is its stated source: the citation_count of every evolution record, the two unmeasurable artifacts included (no added file can move their recorded counts). 20% of the artifacts is not a whole number of artifacts, so both readings are computed: floor (the most artifacts that are at most 20%) and ceil (the fewest that are at least 20%). The added files are synthetic: each names the citation paths of the measurable artifacts among the leaders, once each; a catalogue names every citation path once.
